mentions.h: MATCH v. METROPOLITAN POLICE A.A., BLACKHEATH H. and GRENADIER GUARDS.
mentions.note: won Weight Putt 39ft. 6in., 2nd Discus 116ft. 5½in., 4th High Jump 5ft. 6in.; returned to Switzerland; won Field Events Championship Club medal
had beaten 39ft. 1in. in the Shot Putt in Club events

share.d: Pfenninger in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1934–1938: 3 mentions in 3 issues and 1 race result.
